headline: Chapati vending machine among projects from University of Nottingham
context: Dezeen School Shows: a vending machine distributing fresh, hot chapatis in corporate canteens in India is among the projects from the University of Nottingham. Also featured is a wearable open-water monitoring system and an automated vinyl playback system for uninterrupted music
